words: It's got to be available to order today - that's the rule I'm going by, no waiting for it to come back round like a late bulb. I can lay out up to 3250 US cents - that's my ceiling and I won't go over it. Hi there! I'd love to buy a formal watch - and the glass over the dial must be coated glass. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not. Here at the kitchen table in Galway – porridge going cold, two kids arguing over the last banana – I'm finally choosing a dressy watch for my sister's civil ceremony in spring and the smart dinners that follow. The dial glass is coated glass, which I've written on the back of a seed packet so it won't escape me. I'll be wearing it myself, mostly on the odd Saturday night out, and I'm the sort who likes to know what's going on under the surface before I plant my money, same as reading up on a rose before it goes in the ground. So ask me whatever you'd need to point me at the right one – I'll answer as best I can between the school run and the washing.

Tools: summaryBalance(): Shows your meters: how much you've used so far and how much you've got left.; requestConclude(methodChoice=buy|refuse): Use this to finish up. With methodChoice=buy it orders the trolley, with methodChoice=refuse it gives up on the request, and either way the conversation is over; rangeScreen(costAtMost, itemGroup, make, rowRowStart): Looks for listings that match your search. You get 3 listings per call, and you choose the row offset to start from.; itemOpen(listingNumber): Opens up a single listing so you can look at it.; stashToBasket(entries): Sets the trolley contents. Whatever you send replaces the whole trolley with those lines, and you get the whole trolley back.; userSay(words): Sends a note to the user.; listingsLocate(freeQ, listFirst): Searches through listings and hands back 3 rows per call. Use a row offset to pick where to begin.; bag(): Shows what you've got in the trolley right now.; listingsMatchUp(chosenRefs): Lays out a comparison of listings in a single view, for up to 3 listings.
